model.semantics: probability that Ale wins conditional on submitting the simulated bid
model.rival_bid_distribution: weighted empirical P10/P25/P50/P75/P90/P95; P90 is displayed competitive high and P95 drives upper-tail win risk
model.tie_policy: conservative: equal rival bid is not counted as safely beaten
model.hidden_rivals: residual participation mass retained with a Poisson survival approximation
model.calibration_method: temporal holdout champion among raw, shrink and regularized logistic; safety shrink if curve cannot beat prevalence baseline
model.language_policy: probability follows observed rival-bid tails; aggressive and ceiling are amount anchors and must not collapse at an arbitrary slider maximum
model.secure_strategy: competitive P90 amount, not a forced 95% probability target
model.coverage_ceiling_strategy: empirical P95 rational amount with a bounded tail extension

direct_market_challenger.method: walk-forward weighted empirical CDF of the maximum rival bid / contemporaneous VM
direct_market_challenger.policy: recent holdout selects the informative central curve; P90/P95 rival quantiles restore a mathematically coherent upper tail without forcing 95/98% at implausible bids

market_demand_gate.win_floor_semantics: if every modeled rival skips the player, Ale wins any valid bid; therefore win probability cannot be lower than modeled no-rival probability

rival_context.principle: manager participation history is conditional on player demand and current manager constraints; full/scarce squads, useful budget and gameweek urgency alter entry probability
rival_context.no_rival_probability: product of visible adjusted non-entry probabilities times Poisson survival for hidden residual rival mass
